provenance.method: Bounded review of current Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland official transition/additional-support guidance; combined only as a multi-jurisdiction signpost.

name: UK school and college transition support signposts
description: Official starting points for additional-support and transition planning in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, with an explicit reminder that education systems are devolved.
intended_use: Finding the relevant national framework when a school, college or post-school transition needs additional planning and support.
audience_or_context: Children, young people, families and supporters in the United Kingdom; education law and planning mechanisms differ by nation and local authority.
limitations: This signpost does not create one UK-wide transition entitlement or process.
England uses a different SEND framework and local arrangements; existing ND Oracle England education routes should be used for that jurisdiction.
Individual plans and legal rights require the relevant education authority, setting or adviser.
cost_or_access_notes: Official information is free; local support availability varies.
